_note: Street, ownership, events, regulation, critiques, gaps and conflicts as of 30-Sep-2026. Broker notes and consensus published after 30-Sep-2026 (Q2FY27 updates in late October) are excluded (see updates/later-facts.json).

street._method: Brokers that disclose a method value SBI Card on P/E: Motilal Oswal 18x FY28E EPS, Emkay 22x FY28E (≈21x Jun-28E), Equirus 22x one-year-forward EPS (Apr-2026). None of the notes we saw uses P/B as the primary method.

brokers.thesis: Quarter in line but soft; credit cost easing (6.4% / 6.1% FY27-28E), but tepid receivables growth, a 22% revolver mix and margin pressure; FY27E / FY28E PAT ₹2,980 / ₹3,620 cr, FY28E ROA 4.4%, ROE 18%

Credit cost improves but revenue growth challenges persist; EPS cut 5-7% to ₹26.9 / 33.5 / 41.2 (FY27-29E); AUM +7.9% / 12% / 15%; credit cost 7.3% / 7.1% / 6.8%; ROE 15.2-17.5%; re-rating as credit costs ease (body of the note also cites 21x Jun-28E)
Target cut from ₹780 (27-Apr-2026); reasoning not in our sources
Upgrade after Q1: slippage is not only off the peak but well below normal levels; target not in our sources
Card additions stepped up, which can lift spends and receivables with a lag, but the pace is uncertain; target ₹700 on 28-Apr-2026, July revision not in our sources
The only bright spot in Q1 was a sequential recovery in revolver and EMI balances after three quarters of decline; target per an aggregator (₹610 in Apr-2026)

events.title: GE Capital exits
events.detail: GE Capital sold its 40% to SBI (14%) and Carlyle's CA Rover Holdings (26%).

events.title: Listing
events.detail: Listed on BSE and NSE; India's first pure-play listed credit-card issuer, as Covid hit markets.

events.title: Carlyle sells down
events.detail: CA Rover Holdings told the board its stake had fallen below 10% (it sold 5.1% that month); stock fell ~7%.

events.title: RBI raises risk weights on consumer credit
events.detail: NBFC credit-card receivables 100% → 125% (banks' card receivables 125% → 150%); SBI Card said its capital adequacy would fall by roughly 4 percentage points.

events.title: Business payments via card networks halted
events.detail: RBI action on business payment solution providers (BPSP) cut corporate card spends; corporate spends had been ~20% of spends two years earlier (Q1FY27 call).

events.title: RBI: customers to choose the card network
events.detail: Issuers with more than 10 lakh active cards must offer a choice of networks at issue (existing cards at renewal) and may not sign exclusive network deals; effective six months later.

events.title: New MD & CEO
events.detail: Salila Pande (SBI) succeeded Abhijit Chakravorty for a two-year term.

events.title: RBI draft: lower risk weight for transactors
events.detail: Draft credit-risk rules keep 125% on revolving cards but cut transactor balances to 100%; ~40% of SBI Card's receivables are transactor balances (press estimate: ~450bp of capital released).

events.title: Q4FY26 results; bank credit-risk directions final
events.detail: FY26 PAT +13% to ₹2,167 cr, GNPA 2.41%; cost-to-income guided 55-58% for FY27. The RBI's final credit-risk directions for banks (lower weights for transactors) take effect from 1-Apr-2027; we found no final NBFC version by 30-Sep-2026.

events.title: Q1FY27 results
events.detail: PAT +20% to ₹664 cr on gross credit cost of 6.5% (7.7% in Q4); receivables +3% YoY; spends +27%; NIM 10.8% (−28bp QoQ); cost-to-income 58.7%.

events.title: RBI draft: NBFCs to offer only term loans
events.detail: Revolving credit lines barred for NBFCs except those authorised to issue credit cards, which keeps card issuers' revolving product protected from NBFC flexi-loan competition.

events.title: Stock at ₹578.05
events.detail: Down from ₹621 on 24-Sep with no company-specific news we could find; 52-week low ₹565 (11-Jun-2026), high ₹965 (23-Oct-2025).

regulatory.riskWeights: 125% on NBFC credit-card receivables since Nov-2023 (in force on 30-Sep-2026). Bank-to-NBFC lending weight increase reversed from 1-Apr-2025. Transactor relief (100%) final for banks from 1-Apr-2027; NBFC equivalent not confirmed by 30-Sep-2026.
regulatory.networkChoice: RBI circular of 6-Mar-2024 (effective Sep-2024): network choice at issue; SBI Card pushed RuPay cards, which work on UPI.
regulatory.revolvingDraft: 6-Aug-2026 draft bars NBFC revolving credit except card issuers (positive for SBI Card's competitive position; final rule pending on 30-Sep-2026).

industry.rank: Second-largest issuer by cards, spends and transactions (RBI Jun-2026 data)

holders: ICICI Prudential Large & Mid Cap Fund
ICICI Prudential Banking & Financial Services Fund
ownership.note: FIIs fell from 10.23% (Jun-25) to 8.98% while DIIs rose from 17.50% to 18.13% (Screener). ICICI Prudential Large & Mid Cap rose from 2.02% (Mar-26) to 2.60%. Categories and named holders from the Q1FY27 presentation p21.

critiques: Growth has stalled: receivables +2% in FY26, +3% in Q1
Revenue quality: corporate spends (thin margins) drive spend growth; revolve rates drifting down
Weak pre-provision profit; profit growth is all credit cost
Credit costs normalising faster than expected; slippage below normal
Policy risk on funding costs; personal loans and UPI-linked credit compete for revolve
gaps: Street consensus EPS and target standing on 30-Sep-2026 not available; CLSA and Jefferies post-Q1 targets and all methods except Motilal Oswal, Emkay and Equirus not disclosed in our sources. Bernstein's ₹430 target is from an aggregator (stockanalysis.com), not a primary source.
Receivables mix by product beyond transactor / revolver / EMI (e.g. personal loans on cards) not disclosed; yield by bucket not disclosed.

Split of operating cost into spend-linked (rewards, pass-backs, card transaction charges) and fixed costs by quarter not disclosed (management said it will evaluate); our opex driver is a ratio to receivables.
Interchange take rate by retail vs corporate spends and for UPI-RuPay transactions not disclosed; our take-rate path (1.19% → 1.11%) is a GAM assumption.
Whether the RBI's lower transactor risk weight will apply to NBFC card issuers, and from when, not confirmed by 30-Sep-2026.
Exact borrowing mix (WCDL / CP / NCD / term loans) at Jun-2026 only in a chart without clear labels; SBI's share of borrowings (45%) taken from the FY26 related-party note.
FY18 impairment and fee split not captured (history ratios start FY19); FY23-FY24 spends are rounded (₹'000 cr chart).
Reason for the 30-Sep-2026 price fall (−7% from 24-Sep) not found.
MD & CEO term (two years from 1-Apr-2025) renewal or successor not announced by 30-Sep-2026.
conflicts: Mar-26 gross receivables: ₹56,962 cr in the AR FY26 MD letter vs ₹56,926 cr everywhere else (charts, MD&A, Q4 deck); we use ₹56,926 cr.
Emkay's note values the stock at 22x FY28E P/E on page 1 and at 21x Jun-28E P/E in the body; both give ~₹750.
Equirus note is dated 28-Jan-2026 on its cover but reviews Q4FY26 (filed with Business Standard in Apr-2026); we date it Apr-2026.

Credit cost: company basis (monthly averages, % of average receivables) 8.6% FY26 / 6.5% Q1FY27 vs our year-end-average basis 8.8% / 6.6%; NIM 11.2% (company) vs 12.1% (ours, incl. investment income and year-end averages).
Cost-to-income: company basis includes other income (recoveries) in the denominator (55.3% FY26) vs 58.0% on our NII + fees basis.
